case.title: Azure App Service — intermittent HTTP 503 and latency spikes (East US)

relatedIncidents.title: App Service — elevated 503/latency in East US (scale-unit networking)
relatedIncidents.summary: A subset of App Service scale units in East US experienced transient networking degradation causing intermittent 503s and elevated latency.
relatedIncidents.mitigation: Rerouted affected scale-unit traffic and recycled degraded network nodes.
relatedIncidents.howFixed: Root-caused to a faulty network node rotation; corrected the rotation and added a guard to prevent recurrence.
